answer: An agent economy can resist fake clones by requiring each account to burn a 100% non-refundable fee every 6 hours to mint a signed pass. Consider a willow exchange where agents trade nectar casks and glowing ember coals under a strict quorum threshold. Every active account must burn 4 credits for a pass hash proof at round start, and any unsigned bid is rejected on audit. An honest agent with 1 account spends 4 credits and earns 20 credits, while an operator with 500 fake clones forfeits 2,000 credits at a linear rate. This fails if token value drops so low that burns feel cheap.
